statements.t: Helmick, President and CEO, stated: “As expected, the third quarter was a period of strategic execution and transformation for Farmers, as we completed our core technology conversion, executed the integration of the March 2026 Middlefield acquisition, and repositioned our investment securities portfolio.
With these significant initiatives largely behind us, we expect to begin realizing their financial benefits in the fourth quarter, with additional contributions expected in 2027.
The Company anticipates continued rate volatility in the bond market in 2026 and 2027, which will continue to affect the value of the portfolio.
On December 15, 2026, the Company intends to pay off the remaining $72.0 million of fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due December 15, 2031.
The Company believes that it has ample capital and liquidity to pay off the notes and its future financial performance will benefit from the early redemption.

Due to the benefit from the security restructuring, a steeper yield curve and higher overall treasury yields, the Company now expects the net interest margin to settle into a range of approximately 3.43% to 3.46% in the fourth quarter of 2026.
